component.name: Pinna
component.summary: Battery, noise control and settings for AirPods

description.p: Pinna connects your AirPods and Beats, shows the battery of each bud and the case, and lets you change the settings you would otherwise need an iPhone for.

ul.li: Noise cancellation, transparency and adaptive mode
Ear detection that pauses and resumes any media player
Conversation awareness, press and hold modes, head tracking
A tray icon and a small card when you open the case
Battery history and an estimate of the listening time left
